catalog.description: Target a nearby unit, player, or object by its handle from the perception snapshot.
catalog.name: set_target

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the object to target.

catalog.description: Turn in place to face a nearby object by handle, or a specific x,y position, without otherwise moving.
catalog.name: face

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the object to face. Mutually exclusive with x/y.

x.description: Target X coordinate. Requires y; mutually exclusive with guid.

y.description: Target Y coordinate. Requires x; mutually exclusive with guid.

catalog.description: Walk in a straight line to a point on the ground, stopping within stop_distance yards. No pathfinding — obstacles will block it (returns ok=False, error='stuck'). Blocks until arrival, stuck, or stopped.
catalog.name: move_to

stop_distance.description: How close counts as arrived, in yards. Default 1.0.

z.description: Destination Z coordinate. Optional — omit to stay level with the current height (no terrain data in v1).

catalog.description: Chase a nearby unit or player by handle, re-targeting its position every tick, stopping within stop_distance yards. Blocks until arrival, stuck, the target leaving perception, or stopped.
catalog.name: move_towards

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the object to move towards.

stop_distance.description: How close counts as arrived, in yards. Default 1.0.

catalog.description: Stop any in-progress move_to/move_towards immediately.
catalog.name: stop_movement

catalog.description: Target and start melee auto-attack on a nearby hostile unit.
catalog.name: auto_attack

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the unit to attack.

catalog.description: Stop melee auto-attack.
catalog.name: stop_attack

catalog.description: Do nothing this cycle (wait and watch). Always a valid choice.
catalog.name: idle

catalog.description: Cast a known spell, optionally on a target (defaults to self if target_guid is omitted).
catalog.name: cast_spell

spell_id.description: Spell ID to cast — must be in the agent's spellbook.

target_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the unit to cast on. Omit to cast on self.

catalog.description: Interact with a nearby NPC or gameobject by handle: opens its gossip, vendor, or trainer window (whichever its flags indicate), or activates it directly if it's a gameobject. Must be within 5.0 yd — use move_towards first if not.
catalog.name: interact

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the NPC or gameobject to interact with.

catalog.description: Select an option in the currently open gossip window by its index.
catalog.name: gossip_select

code.description: Text for options that require a text-entry box (rare; the window's option marks `coded: true` when needed).

option_index.description: The option's `index` from the open gossip window.

catalog.description: Buy an item from the vendor window currently open for vendor_guid, identified by vendor slot or item entry (from the window's items list). Waits for the server's confirmation/failure response before returning, so ok=True means the purchase actually went through.
catalog.name: buy_item

entry.description: Item entry, as an alternative to slot.

slot.description: Vendor slot from the open window's items list.

vendor_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the open vendor.

catalog.description: Sell an item at bag/slot to the vendor window currently open for vendor_guid. Resolves the item's GUID from bag/slot (UM-42's inventory model) and waits for the server's confirmation/failure response before returning.
catalog.name: sell_item

bag.description: Bag byte of the item (255 = equipped items/backpack).

count.description: How many to sell from the stack. Default: whole stack.

vendor_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the vendor to sell to.

catalog.description: Learn a spell from the trainer window currently open for trainer_guid. Waits for the server's confirmation/failure response before returning, so ok=True means the spell was actually learned.
catalog.name: train_spell

spell_id.description: Spell ID from the open trainer window's spells list.

trainer_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the open trainer.

catalog.description: Invite a player to a party/group by name.
catalog.name: invite_to_group

catalog.description: Accept the currently pending party invite (see the snapshot's pending_invite).
catalog.name: accept_group

catalog.description: Decline the currently pending party invite (see the snapshot's pending_invite).
catalog.name: decline_group

catalog.description: Leave the party you are in (see the snapshot's group).
catalog.name: leave_group

catalog.description: Hand party leadership to a member of your group (you must be the leader).
catalog.name: promote_leader

name.description: Exact name of the group member to make leader.

catalog.description: Close the currently open gossip/vendor/trainer window.
catalog.name: close_window

catalog.description: Loot a nearby lootable corpse/creature (UNIT_DYNFLAG_LOOTABLE): opens the loot window, takes all money and every item (v1: take-everything, no selective looting), then releases it. Must be within 5 yards.
catalog.name: loot

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the lootable corpse/creature.

catalog.description: Use/consume an item from inventory — e.g. eat food or drink water. Not usable while in combat (server-enforced for most consumables; checked here too).
catalog.name: use_item

bag.description: Bag byte (255 = equipped items/backpack; see CMSG_USE_ITEM's bag field).

slot.description: Slot within that bag (0-18 equipment, 19-22 equipped bags, 23-38 backpack).

target_guid.description: Optional target snapshot handle (a string like "p1"), e.g. a bandage used on an ally. Omit to target self.

catalog.description: Permanently destroy `count` of the item at bag/slot. Irreversible — requires confirm=true as an explicit safety guard against accidental calls.
catalog.name: destroy_item

confirm.description: Must be true — a safety guard, not read by the server.

count.description: How many to destroy from the stack.

catalog.description: Compare two items at given bag/slot positions for the character's own class (UM-69 v1 heuristic: primary stat for class + item level as a tiebreaker, no talent/spec awareness — see agent.item_compare's docstring). Returns which item scores higher and a human-readable reason.
catalog.name: compare_items

bag_a.description: Bag byte of the first item (255 = equipped items/backpack).

bag_b.description: Bag byte of the second item (255 = equipped items/backpack).

slot_a.description: Inventory slot of the first item.

slot_b.description: Inventory slot of the second item.

catalog.description: Equip the item at bag/slot (CMSG_AUTOEQUIP_ITEM) — the server picks the equip slot from the item itself. Refuses up front if the item's cached template says it can't be used by this character (wrong armor type, class-restricted); otherwise waits for the server's confirmation/failure response before returning, so ok=True means the item was actually equipped.
catalog.name: equip_item

bag.description: Bag byte of the item (255 = equipped items/backpack).

catalog.description: Accept a quest offered by a nearby questgiver. Requires that NPC's quest list/quest details window, or a gossip window listing the quest, to already be open (interact() with the NPC first) and the quest to be present in it.
catalog.name: accept_quest

npc_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the questgiver NPC.

quest_id.description: Quest ID to accept, from the open quest_list/quest_details/gossip window.

catalog.description: Tell a nearby questgiver you're ready to turn in quest_id — the first step of turning a quest in. Opens the request-items or offer-reward window (check the perception snapshot's `window` after calling this); use turn_in_quest to actually finish once that window is open.
catalog.name: complete_quest

npc_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the questgiver NPC.

quest_id.description: Quest ID to complete, from quest_log.

catalog.description: Finish turning in quest_id at a nearby questgiver, picking reward_choice (index into the open offer-reward window's reward_choice_items, if any). Requires the offer-reward window to already be open (call complete_quest first).
catalog.name: turn_in_quest

npc_guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the questgiver NPC.

reward_choice.description: Index of the reward item to pick, from the open window's reward_choice_items. Default 0.

catalog.description: Drop a quest from the quest log by its slot number. Irreversible.
catalog.name: abandon_quest

slot.description: Quest log slot (0-24), from quest_log's `slot` field — not the quest id.

catalog.description: Request a trade with a nearby player. Must be within 11.1 yd. The other side sees the request and decides via accept_trade_request.
catalog.name: open_trade

guid.description: Snapshot handle (a string like "u3") of the player to trade with.

catalog.description: Accept a pending incoming trade request (see the trade window's `phase`: 'requested').
catalog.name: accept_trade_request

catalog.description: Put an item from your bag/slot into the open trade's next free slot (0-5; pass trade_slot to pick a specific one). Offers the item's whole stack — trade doesn't support splitting a partial count. Rejected if the item is soulbound.
catalog.name: offer_item

bag.description: Bag byte of the item (255 = equipped items/backpack).

trade_slot.description: Which of the 6 trade slots (0-5) to put it in. Default: the first free one.

catalog.description: Set the gold (in copper) offered in the open trade. Replaces any previous amount.
catalog.name: offer_gold

amount.description: Copper to offer (100 copper = 1 silver, 10000 = 1 gold). 0 clears a previous offer.

catalog.description: Accept the open trade — but only given what you currently believe the other side is offering (from the trade window's `their_gold`/`their_items`). Rejected if that no longer matches the live offer, so re-check the window before calling this again; a change on either side after an accept un-accepts both sides automatically (server behavior), so this never lets a stale offer through silently.
catalog.name: accept_trade

expected_their_gold.description: Gold you believe the other side has offered. Default 0.

expected_their_item_entries.description: Item entries you believe the other side has offered (any order). Omit/empty if you believe they're offering no items.

catalog.description: Cancel/decline the pending or open trade.
catalog.name: cancel_trade

catalog.description: Open the nearest mailbox within 5 yd and request its inbox (check the perception snapshot's `mailbox` after calling this).
catalog.name: open_mailbox

catalog.description: Send mail (with optional gold and one optional item) to a player by name — works even if they're offline or far away. Costs 30 copper postage in addition to any gold sent. Requires a nearby mailbox.
catalog.name: send_mail

bag.description: Bag byte of an item to attach (255 = equipped items/backpack). Omit to send no item.

slot.description: Inventory slot of the item to attach — required together with bag.

catalog.description: Take all money and every item attached to mail_id from the currently open mailbox window (call open_mailbox first) — v1 take-everything, no selective taking, same as loot().
catalog.name: take_mail

mail_id.description: Mail id, from the open mailbox window's `mails` list.

catalog.description: Delete mail_id from the currently open mailbox window (call open_mailbox first). Irreversible — take any attachments first, they're lost otherwise.
catalog.name: delete_mail

mail_id.description: Mail id, from the open mailbox window's `mails` list.

catalog.description: After dying, release your spirit to become a ghost at the graveyard. Required before a corpse run/reclaim_corpse.
catalog.name: release_spirit

catalog.description: Walk to your corpse and resurrect there. Falls back to the nearest spirit healer if the corpse can't be reached (obstacle, out of range, or no corpse perceived). Asks the server for the corpse position if unknown. Requires release_spirit first.
catalog.name: reclaim_corpse

catalog.description: Follow a nearby party member/player by name, keeping roughly `distance` yards away and matching their target if assist is on, until stop_following is called or the leader is lost.
catalog.name: follow

distance.description: How close to stay, in yards. Default 3.0.

player_name.description: Name of a nearby player to follow (case-insensitive).

catalog.description: Turn assisting the followed leader's current combat target on or off.
catalog.name: assist

on.description: True to assist, false to stop assisting.

catalog.description: Stop following the current leader and stop assisting.
catalog.name: stop_following

catalog.description: Rest to recover HP/mana: eats/drinks if inventory has food, otherwise sits. Stops automatically once healed or attacked. This also runs as an automatic reflex whenever HP/mana drop low out of combat, so this action is mainly for resting proactively before a fight you can see coming.
catalog.name: rest
